title: How One Confession Kills What a Godly Man Keeps Managing Instead of Killing
caption:
"Struggling with something" is a sin wearing a disguise.

Call the lust lust, the anger anger, the laziness laziness. You can't kill what you won't name, and you can't outlast what you're only managing. Managing it is a private project you renew every Monday. Killing it takes one honest conversation.

Not the whole group chat. One brother, one honest sentence: "here's what I'm actually fighting." What you hide grows. What you confess starts dying the moment it's said out loud.

"Confess your sins to one another... that you may be healed." (James 5:16)

A man of God doesn't manage his sin. He kills it.
